description.zh: 账号名，只能是英文大小写、数字、汉字及短划线（-）的自由组合
description.en: The account name. The name can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 账户公钥，属于hash值，固定128个字符
description.en: The public key of the account. The value is a hash value that contains 128 characters.

description.zh: 账户恢复公钥，属于hash值，固定128个字符
description.en: The recovery public key of the account. The value is a hash value that contains 128 characters.

title.zh: 在一条蚂蚁区块链上创建一个账户
title.en: Create an account on an ant blockchain
